description: A dramatic staircase hallway photographed from a low angle looking upward, with a wide lens capturing the full height of a two-story open stair. The composition emphasizes the strong diagonal lines of the stair rail running from lower-left to upper-right, creating a dynamic angular geometry against the grid window. The mood is modern, airy, and architecturally crisp.
